code:
-- WRONG: never matches, even on real NULLs
WHERE vendor_site_id = NULL

-- CORRECT
WHERE vendor_site_id IS NULL
caption: NULL is never equal to anything, including another NULL — = NULL silently returns nothing.
100 + NULL = NULL — an unguarded NULL can silently wipe out a calculation.

code:
SELECT invoice_num,
       NVL2(discount_amount_taken,
            'Discount Taken', 'No Discount') AS discount_status
FROM ap_invoices_all;
caption: One expression instead of a full CASE statement for a simple either/or label.
COALESCE returns the first non-NULL value — with 2 arguments it behaves exactly like NVL.
